description: Defines classes and methods related to transport socket connection jobs, including host resolution, IPv6 fallback logic, and connection management within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: TransportSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for establishing a transport socket connection, including destination endpoint, security policies, and ALPN protocols.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of resolving hostnames and establishing TCP connections, with IPv6 fallback logic and support for parallel IPv4/IPv6 connection attempts.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob::Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of TransportConnectJob.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob::EndpointResultOverride
classes.description: Overrides for host resolver endpoint results, including result status and DNS aliases.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::TransportConnectJob
methods.description: Constructor for initiating a transport connection job with optional endpoint override.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the connection attempt.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection has been established.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetResolveErrorInfo
methods.description: Provides information on hostname resolution errors.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Returns the current host resolver endpoint result.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::ConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for connection attempts.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::StartIPv4JobAsync
methods.description: Initiates an IPv4 connection attempt asynchronously after IPv6 fallback timer.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Adjusts the priority of the connection attempt.
